POSTHOG_API_KEY.description: PostHog Personal API Key created with the 'MCP server' preset and READ-only scopes (format phx_XXXXXXXX). Sent to the server as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. Gitignored — never commit; store only in the fleet .env.

POSTHOG_HOST.description: PostHog MCP endpoint host — 'mcp.posthog.com' for US Cloud (default) or 'mcp-eu.posthog.com' for EU Cloud. This is the MCP proxy host, NOT the app host (us.posthog.com / eu.posthog.com). Self-hosted instances: see library/integrations/posthog.md.

POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID.description: Numeric PostHog project ID to pin queries to (bare number, e.g. 12345). Required for read-only use: pinning the project supplies query context so the session never needs the write-only switch-project tool.
